title: Your GHL Lead Journey: No Duplicates, No Follow-Up After Booking

sections.label: 1 - EVERY LEAD LANDS AS ONE CONTACT
sections.note: Your parts 6 and 7: forms, surveys, tags, custom fields and missed-call text back. Whether they fill in a form or you miss their call, they land as one contact with a tag saying where they came from.

sections.label: 2 - FOLLOW-UP THAT KNOWS WHEN TO STOP
sections.note: Your parts 1, 2 and 8: SMS and email follow-up, the stop rules and the if/else check. Duplicate texts come from two workflows listening to the same trigger, so one workflow owns each lead, and one stop rule covers replies, bookings, opportunities and DND.

sections.label: 3 - BOOKED, REMINDED, MOVED DOWN THE PIPELINE
sections.note: Your parts 3 and 4: appointment reminders and follow-ups, pipeline and opportunity automation. Once they book, the follow-up is already off and only appointment messages go out.

sections.label: 4 - THE RIGHT PERSON HEARS ABOUT IT
sections.note: Your part 5: lead routing and internal notifications. Each lead has one owner, and that person is told the moment something needs them.

sections.label: 5 - CLEAN UP YOUR WORKFLOWS, THEN TEST THE WHOLE JOURNEY
sections.note: Your parts 9 and 10: reviewing your existing workflows for conflicts or unnecessary steps, then testing the complete lead journey and fixing what does not behave.
